result.topic_en: Second part of Riemann's Paris prize essay on heat conduction: conditions under which the quadratic differential form sum b ds ds can be transformed into a form with constant coefficients (sum dx^2), deriving relations among the first and second derivatives of the coordinate transformation.
result.transcription:
12.

Pars secunda.
De transformatione expressionis $\sum_1^n{}^\iota \sum_1^n{}^{\iota'} (b_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'})$ in
formam datam $\sum_{\iota,\iota'} a_{\iota,\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$.

Quum quaestio ab Ill$^{ma}$ Academia ad corpora homogenea restricta sit,
in quibus conductibilitates resultantes sint constantes, evolvamus primum
conditiones, ut expressio $\sum_{\iota,\iota'} b_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$, aequando quantitates $s$ functioni-
bus ipsarum $x$, in formam $\sum a_{\iota,\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$ constantibus coefficientibus $a_{\iota,\iota'}$
affectam transformari possit. Deinde de transformatione in formam
quamlibet datam pauca adjiciemus.

Expressionem $\sum_{\iota,\iota'} a_{\iota,\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$ coefficientibus constantibus affectam, si est,
id quod supponimus, forma positiva ipsarum $dx$, semper in formam
$\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ redigi posse constat. Unde si $\sum_{\iota,\iota'} b_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ in formam $\sum_{\iota,\iota'} a_{\iota,\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$
transformari potest, redigi etiam potest in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ et vice versa.
Quaeramus igitur, quando in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ transformari possit.

Sit determinans $\sum \pm b_{1,1} b_{2,2} \ldots b_{n,n} = B$ et determinantes partiales $= \beta_{\iota,\iota'}$,
quo pacto erit $\sum_\iota \beta_{\iota,\iota'} b_{\iota,\iota'} = B$ et $\sum_\iota \beta_{\iota,\iota'} b_{\iota,\iota''} = 0$, si $\iota' \gtrless \iota''$.

Si $\sum b_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ pro valoribus quibuslibet ipsarum $dx$, substituendo
$d+\delta$ pro $d$ invenitur, etiam $\sum b_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota dx_\iota \delta x_\iota$ pro valoribus quibuslibet
ipsarum $dx$ et $\delta x$. Hinc si quantitates $ds_\iota$ per $dx_\iota$, et quantitates $\delta x_\iota$ per quanti-
tates $\delta s_\iota$ exprimuntur sequitur esse

(1) $\frac{\partial x_{\nu'}}{\partial s_\nu} = \sum_\iota b_{\nu,\iota} \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_{\nu'}}$

et proinde

(2) $\frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_{\nu'}} = \sum_\nu \frac{\beta_{\nu,\iota}}{B} \frac{\partial x_{\nu'}}{\partial s_\nu}$

Unde porro deducitur, quum sit $\sum_\nu \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu} \frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_\iota} = 1$ et $\sum \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu} \frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_{\iota'}} = 0$ si $\iota \lessgtr \iota'$

(3) $\sum_\nu \frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_\iota} \frac{\partial x_\nu}{\partial s_{\iota'}} = b_{\iota,\iota'}$ \quad (4) $\sum_\nu \frac{\partial s_\iota}{\partial x_\nu} \frac{\partial s_{\iota'}}{\partial x_\nu} = \frac{\beta_{\iota,\iota'}}{B}$

et differentiando formulam posteriorem {+(priorem?)+}

$\sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_\iota \partial s_{\iota''}} \frac{\partial x}{\partial s_{\iota'}} + \sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'} \partial s_{\iota''}} \frac{\partial x}{\partial s_\iota} = \frac{\partial b_{\iota,\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}}$

Jam ex his ipsarum $\frac{\partial b_{\iota,\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}}, \frac{\partial b_{\iota,\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'}}, \frac{\partial b_{\iota',\iota''}}{\partial s_\iota}$ expressionibus eruitur

(5) $2\sum \frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_{\iota'} \partial s_{\iota''}} \frac{\partial x}{\partial s_\iota} = \frac{\partial b_{\iota,\iota'}}{\partial s_{\iota''}} + \frac{\partial b_{\iota,\iota''}}{\partial s_{\iota'}} - \frac{\partial b_{\iota',\iota''}}{\partial s_\iota}$

et si haec quantitas per $p_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$ designatur

items.english: Let us first develop the conditions under which the expression sum b ds ds, by setting the quantities s equal to functions of the x, can be transformed into the form sum a dx dx with constant coefficients a. Then we shall add a few remarks on transformation into any given form.

items.quote: Quaeramus igitur, quando in formam $\sum_\iota dx_\iota^2$ transformari possit.
items.english: Let us therefore ask when it can be transformed into the form sum dx^2.
